messages:
Iris (PM): Quick check-in on post-launch packing: we shipped v1.2 last night. Need to agree how we split work next 2 sprints across urgent customer fixes, high-touch EAP asks, and backlog cleanups. Short thread pls.

Diego (Eng): Can we rank by customer impact *and* by risk to rollout? Some fixes look easy but could touch caching layer.

Priya (Design): Two UX items from NPS: onboarding microcopy and modal alignment. Low effort, improves perceived polish.

Liam (Customer Success): EAP customer "NovaHealth" requested configurable timeout for inference; they're blocked on a compliance test. They offered to fund eng time.

Iris (PM): OK, proposal: 1) Immediate hotfix bucket (regressions & blockages) — reserve 4 dev-days next week. 2) Funded EAP work — treat as ASAP if contract ok. 3) Low-effort polish — batch into next sprint if <=2 dev-days each. 4) Backlog items >3 dev-days schedule into roadmap.

Ruth (SRE): For hotfixes, require canary + rollback plan. deploy-bot should gate any hotfix merge with a staging performance test.

deploy-bot: staging perf test queued: perf/staging/3412345670. Will post results.

Diego (Eng): On regression list: two infra bugs (cache invalidation + model routing), one datastore index causing p95 spikes. Cache fix estimate 2d, routing 4d, index 1d. Routing risky.

Iris (PM): Routing fix impacts many tenants. Can we do a selective canary for NovaHealth first?

Diego (Eng): Yes, we can route NovaHealth to a fallback model variant while we land the routing fix. Requires a feature flag change + short DB migration. Roughly 1d to implement fallback route.

Liam (Customer Success): NovaHealth okay with fallback if it's documented and we notify them. They prefer funded full fix though.

Priya (Design): I'll scope the microcopy and modal tweaks and attach clear acceptance criteria. Should be <1d each.

Iris (PM): Decision checklist for planning: - Ship hotfixes for regressions/blockers (Oleg owns) - Accept funded EAP work outside normal cadence if contract signed (Iris + Liam) - Batch low-effort polish into sprint if <=2d (Priya) - Add backlog refactor items to Q2 roadmap otherwise.

Diego (Eng): I'll pick up cache + index immediately. Routing fix goes to next sprint but we'll implement per-tenant fallback today.

Ruth (SRE): I'll add canary policy: 5% traffic for 24h, monitor p99/p95/errors, auto-rollback on >3x baseline error rate.

Iris (PM): Nice. Action items: Diego (cache+index, fallback), Priya (ACs + UX tickets), Liam (confirm NovaHealth contract), Ruth (canary + monitoring), me (update roadmap + customer comms). Re-evaluate Friday. Any objections? :thumbsup: for go

Liam (Customer Success): :thumbsup:

Priya (Design): :thumbsup: adding tickets now

Diego (Eng): :thumbsup: starting work on cache

Ruth (SRE): :thumbsup: will deploy canary job

Iris (PM): Thanks team, we'll post the sprint adjustment doc after lunch.
